decisions.reason: Having survived the initial trial period and fitting closely with the firm's dental laboratory consumables business, the bleaching tray blanks look like a low-cost option worth keeping open unless later sales prove persistently weak.

The PETG thermoforming blank is highly adjacent to the firm's core materials and workflow offering, so after several years the option appears sufficiently validated and inexpensive to maintain on the market.

The UV-curing lacquer is more peripheral and likely faces a narrower demand base, but as a complementary material with limited continuation cost it still merits being kept unless newer evidence clearly disappoints.

Custom hearing protection earmolds leverage the firm's existing earmold and hearing-care capabilities, so the product line still offers option value and strategic fit despite some risk of pruning if growth remains modest.
